title: Oudomxay residents’ compensation and resettlement demands concerning Luang Prabang Dam
reason: RFA reports residents of 12 villages seeking higher compensation and complaining to local officials about resettlement plans, but describes no public protest gathering or group meeting and gives no attendance. The article supports advocacy/demands, not the required public assembly of 50 or more. Screened out on available evidence; this does not assert that no unreported gathering occurred.
notes: Event date, public gathering and turnout are unknown; publication date 2023-02-17 is not substituted for an event start date.
